name: Driven shot
note: instep drive, a touch of topspin

name: Finesse curl
note: inside of the boot: side spin with a little backspin, the ball turns like a top

name: Trivela
note: outside of the boot: spin axis tilted diagonally, bends away then back

name: Knuckle
note: no spin: the sprite barely turns while the flight wobbles and changes direction sharply

name: Low drive
note: skims low with topspin and bounces in front of the keeper

name: Flat bender (clockwise)
note: struck flat with a little side spin: bends late away from the keeper

name: Lofted finesse
note: inside of the boot, lifted: rises, bends and drops under the bar, slower and loopier than a drive

name: Lofted trivela
note: outside of the boot, lifted: swerves away then back as it drops

name: Bent pass (clockwise)
note: a pass lifted to knee height with heavy side spin from the inside of the boot: bends round a defender into the runner

name: Bent pass (anticlockwise)
note: mirror of K14 (outside of the boot)
